answer: MeterSeal is the gate: a verifier reads signed interval data from each seat's smart meter and rejects any meter serial already bound, so two seats cannot share one wall socket. The penalty trigger is a duplicate serial or a flat load curve, which burns the bond and voids the account. A service connection costs one hundred fifty dollars plus forty five monthly, so N fakes cost N times one hundred ninety five dollars and N installer visits. A rented forge draws real current, a falcon on the ridge can spot one wire feeding two houses, and no proxy hides a meter that never pulls a watt.
